project: Sahaay AI - Flood Vision Dataset Audit

floodnet.source_type: Drone imagery after Hurricane Harvey (Texas, USA)
floodnet.domain_shift_assessment: CRITICAL PERSPECTIVE MISMATCH: FloodNet images are nadir/oblique high-altitude aerial drone shots. Our target application receives street-level citizen smartphone photos. Training exclusively on aerial images causes severe domain failure on ground-level features (e.g. eye-level reflections, curbs, headlight glares, water depth relative to tires).

eu_flood.source_type: Crowdsourced and official event photos during Central Europe Floods (June 2013)
eu_flood.intended_task: Interactive Image Retrieval & Task Relevance Annotation
eu_flood.domain_shift_assessment: EXCELLENT DOMAIN MATCH FOR GROUND-LEVEL CLASSIFICATION: Photos feature streetscapes, cars, sidewalks, flood waters, and dry transport scenes. Crucially provides 327 verified negative images (irrelevant.txt) captured during the event that show no flood waters, alongside 3,151 verified positive flood images.

clemson_floodimg.dataset_name: Clemson FloodIMG (HHR Clemson / Data in Brief 2023)
clemson_floodimg.perspective: Ground-level & CCTV (Twitter/X and USGS/DOT traffic cameras)
clemson_floodimg.source_type: IoT and social media flood event feeds
clemson_floodimg.intended_task: Flood detection, severity estimation, object localization
clemson_floodimg.domain_shift_assessment: STRONG PERSPECTIVE MATCH BUT COMPLETE LACK OF NEGATIVE EXAMPLES: The 9,296 images depict real flood events from ground/traffic camera levels. However, every image is a positive flood event. Only 25 images have object-level polygon annotations. CRITICAL CAUTION: Cannot be used alone for binary supervised classification without pairing with a verified non-flooded negative class.

binary_ground_level.dataset_name: Curated Ground-Level Binary Flood Classification Dataset
binary_ground_level.perspective: Ground-level street photos (mobile, vehicle dashcams, pedestrian)
binary_ground_level.source_type: Curated multi-source street flood disaster imagery paired with normal road scenes
binary_ground_level.intended_task: Binary Image Classification: Flooded vs Non-Flooded
binary_ground_level.domain_shift_assessment: OPTIMAL FOR FIRST PRODUCTION BASELINE: Contains 1,500 flooded street images and 1,500 non-flooded street images (3,000 total). Perfect 50/50 balance. Street-level perspective matches citizen mobile uploads. Negative class includes dry pavement, urban traffic, curbs, sidewalks, and parked cars.

synthesis_and_strategy.supplementary_positive_pool: clemson_floodimg (9,296 images, ground-level flood positives for augmentation/pre-training)
synthesis_and_strategy.aerial_secondary_model: floodnet (requires separate aerial classifier if drone streams are deployed; do not mix directly with citizen phone stream without source tags)
